title: Android TV: install updates from inside the app
summary: When GitHub has a newer release, the app downloads the APK and starts the Android install itself.

fields.why: The Open button in Settings opens the GitHub page in a browser. Many TVs have no browser, so the user cannot update.
fields.done: On a TV with an older version, one click on Update and the Android confirm screen install the new version.
fields.keep: The update check itself and the webOS and desktop apps.
fields.context: The release check is in AppState.kt (GitHub releases/latest API). The row is in SettingsScreen.kt. The install needs the permission REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, and the user allows "Install unknown apps" once. The APK must use the same signing key and a higher versionCode.
